gates.name: Engine 1.5 reproduced
gates.value: intercept 0.619; photons 0.125-0.848; F0 854x (1.5: 854x); best conventional 18x; SR-1 0.59%

gates.name: Fiji constitutive model
gates.value: M(T, H, S) bounded by mu0 Ms_max, zero without seed, hysteretic, collapses at quench and beyond the strain limit; inverse magnetocaloric; no energy created

gates.name: Fiji field
gates.value: liners add 9 mT at the burn point (coils 1.46 T) at the atomic-moment bound (mu0 Ms 3.5 T); the canon law (5 T x 26.3 = 132 T) needs mu0 Ms 5e+04 T in these liners, and 35 T (10x the bound) even in a solid 2-30 m shell around the burn

gates.name: Lattice survival
gates.value: inboard photon flux 2.4e+08-5.6e+09 W/m2, 20-476x what a cooled 5 mm W face passes; a cooled 5 mm Fiji skin would rise 7.9e+04-1.9e+06 K against a 400 K margin to quench: the lattice collapses in line of sight of the burn

gates.name: REBCO margin and fluence
gates.value: Jc margin 6.2x or more at <= 8.0 T (not limiting); fast-neutron fluence at C2 reaches the limit in 2-23 s against a 28.5 d burn: attenuation 1e+05 (about 1.7 m of shield) needed

gates.name: Advanced fusion photon share
gates.value: floor 16.4% at Ti 150 keV (polarized, channelled, Te/Ti 0.60); coupled burn 51.0%; the most any configuration allows is 0.70% (F1-REF); with channeling or a Fiji liner the fixed loads alone exceed the radiator

gates.name: Radiation and thermal closure
gates.value: F6 needs 43x the radiator (24x without the channeling drive and liner losses; coupled burn 93x); F0 854x; no candidate closes

gates.name: Architecture
gates.value: four independent engines, one reusable engine asset; no canon, geometry or deployed-engine change
